explanation: Do not cache get_user for the life of a process: after a role is revoked, a cached user could still have the old role. #640 is the issue reference for this hazard.
For this db.Query call, check err before registering rows.Close() with defer. When the query fails, rows is nil, so trying to close it would be wrong.
Use setTimeout with a zero delay for measure(el), rather than queueMicrotask. The intended reason is to let layout settle before measuring the element.
Do not log the contents of the token's Secret<String> value. Its Debug representation is redacted, so logging that representation must not expose the secret.
Keep the RetryCount constant in sync with the Http.Retry setting in appsettings.json. A change to either value requires a corresponding change to the other.
The offset passed to ch.map must be divisible by pageSize with no remainder. Memory mapping rejects an offset that is not page aligned.
Keep the trailing slash on the rsync source, build/. With that slash, rsync copies the contents of build into $DEST; without it, rsync copies the build directory itself.
The BRIN index on created_at is used for its size advantage: the comment says it is 1% of the size of a B-tree index. That choice relies on events being appended in time order.

Replace this loop, which repeatedly checks flag while waiting, with a futex-based wait. The TODO is complete when lock_acquire in src/sync/lock.c sleeps instead of spin waiting; src/sync/lock.c is the file and lock_acquire is the function.
Consult the failover section of the runbook for why dbo.RebuildStats runs on the secondary. doc:runbook#failover is a documentation reference to that section.
Keep this timeout below 60 seconds because the upstream proxy ends idle requests after 60 seconds. The value 30 satisfies that constraint.
Keep Widget's destructor virtual. If ~Widget() becomes non-virtual, destroying a derived object through a Widget pointer can skip the derived destructor. #915 is the issue reference for this hazard.
Set PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON before any write on this database connection. The setting applies separately to each connection, so enabling it elsewhere does not enable it here.
Use the fixed-length ShortString form, string[40], for Name instead of a regular string. The containing record is written directly to disk byte for byte, so its in-memory representation matters.
Bind caller-supplied p_id through the :1 placeholder in this EXECUTE IMMEDIATE statement. Concatenating caller input into the SQL text would allow SQL injection.
